items.title: Phase Lag and Phase Lead (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Phase Lag and Phase Lead: a main subheading of 17.3 Phase of A.C., its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 90-91.

blocks.text: Figs. 17.5(b) aur 17.5(c) dekhein: t = 0 par angle θ bhi 0° hai. t = 0 par phase angle θ ki qeemat ko AC quantity ka initial phase (shuru ka phase) kehte hain. In equations ke mutabiq:

blocks.text_alt: V = Vₒ sin θ   and   I = Iₒ sin θ   (17.9)

blocks.text: voltage V aur current I dono ka initial phase zero hai, yani dono ek saath chalte hain (in phase). Lekin kai baar current aur voltage in phase nahi hote; un ke phase mein difference (farq) hota hai. Maslan voltage V ka initial phase zero ho aur current I ka initial phase φ ho (Fig. 17.5(b)). Is ki equations:

blocks.text_alt: V = Vₒ sin θ   and   I = Iₒ sin (θ + φ)

blocks.text: t = 0 par voltage V = 0 hai lekin current pehle se positive hai: I = Iₒ sin φ. Matlab current φ angle pehle zero se guzar chuka tha. Is liye kehte hain ke current voltage se φ angle aage (leading) hai (Fig. 17.5(b)). Angle φ voltage aur current ka phase difference (phase ka farq) hai.
Isi tarah current ka initial phase voltage ke comparison (muqable) mein negative bhi ho sakta hai (Fig. 17.5(c)). Is ki equations:

blocks.text_alt: V = Vₒ sin θ   and   I = Iₒ sin (θ − φ)

blocks.text: Ab t = 0 par V zero hai lekin current negative hai: I = −Iₒ sin φ. Current voltage ke φ angle baad zero tak pohanchega. Is liye current voltage se φ angle peeche (lagging) hai. Angle φ, V aur I ka phase difference hai.

blocks.alt: t ke muqable do graph. (b) Positive phase: red current I = Io sin(theta + phi) t = 0 se phi pehle shuru hota, t = 0 par kitab ki tarah Io sin theta likha hai aur green voltage V se pehle +Io par pohanchta hai. (c) Negative phase: current I = Io sin(theta - phi) t = 0 par kitab ki tarah Io sin theta likha hai aur V ke phi baad zero paar karta hai.
